entities.summary: Lyudmyla Lemeshko is a Ukrainian football midfielder, currently playing for Zorky Krasnogorsk in the Russian Championship. She has also played for Lehenda Chernihiv, Gömrükçü Baku, Ryazan VDV and ShVSM Izmailovo, winning five Ukrainian Leagues with Lehenda.
